title: Painting Fence
statementMd:
Bizon the Champion isn't just attentive, he also is very hardworking.

Bizon the Champion decided to paint his old fence his favorite color, orange. The fence is represented as $*n*$ vertical planks, put in a row. Adjacent planks have no gap between them. The planks are numbered from the left to the right starting from one, the $*i*$-th plank has the width of $1$ meter and the height of $*a*_{*i*}$ meters.

Bizon the Champion bought a brush in the shop, the brush's width is $1$ meter. He can make vertical and horizontal strokes with the brush. During a stroke the brush's full surface must touch the fence at all the time (see the samples for the better understanding). What minimum number of strokes should Bizon the Champion do to fully paint the fence? Note that you are allowed to paint the same area of the fence multiple times.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000)$ — the number of fence planks. The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$.

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum number of strokes needed to paint the whole fence.

## Note

In the first sample you need to paint the fence in three strokes with the brush: the first stroke goes on height 1 horizontally along all the planks. The second stroke goes on height 2 horizontally and paints the first and second planks and the third stroke (it can be horizontal and vertical) finishes painting the fourth plank.

In the second sample you can paint the fence with two strokes, either two horizontal or two vertical strokes.

In the third sample there is only one plank that can be painted using a single vertical stroke.
statementZhMd:
Bizon the Champion 不仅细心，而且非常勤奋。

Bizon the Champion 决定把他的旧栅栏刷成自己最喜欢的橙色。栅栏由 $*n*$ 块竖直木板组成，它们依次排列，相邻木板之间没有间隙。木板从左到右编号，编号为 $*i*$ 的木板宽度为 $1$ 米，高度为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 米。

Bizon the Champion 从商店买了一把刷子，刷子的宽度为 $1$ 米。他可以使用刷子进行竖直或水平粉刷。在一次粉刷过程中，刷子的整个表面必须始终与栅栏接触（参见样例以便更好地理解）。Bizon the Champion 至少需要粉刷多少次才能将整个栅栏刷完？注意，允许多次粉刷栅栏的同一部分。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000)$，表示栅栏木板的数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}$、$*a*_{2}$、$...$、$*a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示将整个栅栏刷完所需的最少粉刷次数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，需要用刷子粉刷三次：第一次沿高度 1 水平粉刷所有木板；第二次沿高度 2 水平粉刷第一块和第二块木板；第三次粉刷（可以水平或竖直）完成第四块木板。

在第二个样例中，可以用两次粉刷完成栅栏，既可以进行两次水平粉刷，也可以进行两次竖直粉刷。

在第三个样例中，只有一块木板，可以用一次竖直粉刷完成。
